Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of contactor installation and operation; Safety: De-energize circuit before handling; Supervision: Instructor monitors wiring and testing procedures.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a contactor in an electrical circuit?
How does a polarized relay differ from a standard relay?
Why is it critical to de-energize a circuit before installing a contactor?

development.content:
Construction of polarized relay
Operation of polarized relay contacts
Installation steps for contactor
Safety precautions during installation
Testing contactor operation

Wiring configuration for contactor
Coil energization sequence
Contact closure and arc suppression
Troubleshooting common faults
Maintenance and inspection procedures

Verification of contactor operation
Documentation of installation
Review of safety protocols
Q&A session on operation principles
Preparation for next lesson topic

summary_questions: Explain the role of the polarized relay in controlling the contactor coil.
Describe the steps taken to ensure safe installation of the contactor.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between a Wheatstone bridge and a ratio meter coil, as covered in the next lesson plan (LP 03), focusing on their application in temperature measurement.

pft_rows.syllabus: Measurement of temperature using Wheatstone bridge, ratio meter coil and thermocouple.
